name: Nepali BS Date Tools
author: chudamani shrestha

sections.description:
Nepali BS Date Tools is a wordpress plugin that converts the english date format to nepal date format. This plugin also supports Shortcode that helps you to display Nepali dates anywhere in your website. It also converts english digits to nepali digits.

Perfect for Nepali blogs, news portals, government websites, and local business websites.

Features

  • Convert post date into nepali BS date.
  • Time ago option available
  • Convert the date using function NBSD_convert_to_nepalidate(‘your-date’) or using shortcode [NBSD_convertTonepalidate engdate=”your-date”].
  • Display today date using function NBSD_the_today_nepalidate() or using shortcode [NBSD_the_today_nepalidate].
  • Convert any number into nepali number using function NBSD_convert_to_nepali_number(‘your-number’) or using shortcode [NBSD_convert_to_nepali_number number=’your-number’].

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later license.

Developers

  • manjilshre
sections.installation:
1.Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nepali-bs-date-tools directory, or install the plugin through the wordPress plugins screen directly.
2.Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
3.Go to settings general page and look for ‘Post Date In BS Date Options’ to manage setting of plugin.
4.Use the provided shortcode in posts or pages.
